title: Bill Doler's induction physical
summary: Doler faked a swollen leg and cracked wise to the Army psychiatrist but was still taken and spent four years playing golf in a Florida band.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well, Bill was -- we were now not getting ready to go in the Army and Bill got a -- we used to call it greetings from Uncle Sam, meaning we'd like you to come down and see us, he got his before I got mine and he went down and he was interviewed and Bill did everything -- oh, yes, when we were children, Bill was -- I think we were about ten years old, Bill was riding on a motorcycle and he was -- an automobile ran over and he had a big dent in his leg. Never grew back right, had quite a big dent in his leg and so he thought, 'Well, now, what I'll do is use that to keep out of the Army,' so he took his golf club and he got drunk and he closed his eyes and he banged himself on that and his leg went up to about twice its size and then he went out and got a crutch and he went down for his physical examination and they took him in.

They took him in the Army and there he was. You probably don't know that when you go in the Army you go through a lot of different offices and there are a lot of questions and as you go into each office, you take some clothes off, so finally the last person you see is the psychiatrist and there you are naked.
And Bill is sitting there doing everything he can to get out and he's naked and the psychiatrist is asking him all

these questions. The psychiatrist says to Bill, 'Did you ever have an affair with a man,' and Bill said, 'No, did you,' and the psychiatrist says 'Now, listen, just answer the questions and don't get smart with me,' and Bill said, 'Well, look, if you were sitting here naked and I was sitting there dressed, you wouldn't be so damn smart,' and the man threw up his hands and said, 'Get him out of here.'
